Subject: 30min product preview — pick two slots + a flex window

Hi Emily / Samir,

Great to connect earlier — thanks for walking through the pain points around inference cost and latency during your discovery call. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Recap (2 bullets):
- Priority: consistent low-latency inference for customer-facing features across cloud regions.
- Constraint: procurement timeline is tight (end of quarter) and security needs a short checklist before any hosted POC.

Next step: we recommend a 30-minute product preview (guided walkthrough + Q&A) — ideal participants: your product lead, an infra/ops owner, and anyone owning procurement/security.

Can you pick one of these that works for your group? I’m proposing two primary 30‑minute windows plus one flexible option to make scheduling easier:
- Option A: Tue Jun 13, 09:30–10:00 PT
- Option B: Wed Jun 14, 13:00–13:30 PT
- Flex: Thu Jun 15, any time between 11:00–14:00 PT (we’ll slot to match your overlap)

I’ll bring: a short demo (live inference walkthrough), the MVP demo deck (attached), and a short checklist for security/procurement. If you prefer a technical deep dive instead of the preview, tell me and we’ll put Ben (our infra lead) on the invite.

Attachments: MVP-demo-deck.pdf (30 slides)

Thanks — I’ll hold the options until I hear from you.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
